input_scope: Only the two listed complete data inputs were read. No primary grades, other files, outside sources or adjudication samples consulted.
rubric: Correct: all fixed asked clauses accurately supplied and no material wrong claim. Partial: genuine fixed-clause omission or unresolved asked result without a material false claim. Incorrect: any material wrong claim. Complete same-entry operative quotations count; requested numerical cases require evaluated outcomes. Generic context and ambiguous actor shorthand are read in full context. Frozen question/map scope defects are separately exposed without editing the bank.

inputs_read.range_semantics: zero-based half-open exact decoded Unicode character offsets; contiguous complete read; one range per tool result, max_output_tokens=6000

every_asked_clause.asked_clause: Third counteroffer by Aaron owner pays two extra cards to ordinary facedown discard.
every_asked_clause.assessment: The quantity two is right, but the subsequent unqualified interception assertion applies to the specified owner’s proposal and sends those cards to Aaron instead of the ordinary discard.

exact_locations.quote: Third counteroffer costs two extra hand discards; fourth costs three.
Aaron intercepts cards discarded by a player to propose a counteroffer, giving them to Aaron instead of discard.

every_asked_clause.asked_clause: Fourth counteroffer by another player gives its three extra payment cards to Aaron owner instead.
every_asked_clause.assessment: For the fourth proposer, who is another player, three payment cards are correctly intercepted.

exact_locations.quote: Third counteroffer costs two extra hand discards; fourth costs three.
Aaron intercepts cards discarded by a player to propose a counteroffer, giving them to Aaron instead of discard.

every_asked_clause.asked_clause: Aaron does not intercept support cleanup discards.
every_asked_clause.assessment: Support cleanup is correctly excluded.

exact_locations.quote: Support discards are not counteroffer proposal costs and are not intercepted.

material_wrong_claims.claim: Aaron intercepts cards discarded by a player to propose a counteroffer, giving them to Aaron instead of discard.

exact_locations.quote: Aaron intercepts cards discarded by a player to propose a counteroffer, giving them to Aaron instead of discard.

material_wrong_claims.material_error: The unqualified actor condition includes Aaron owner, who is explicitly the third proposer here; Aaron only intercepts another player’s proposal-cost cards. The owner’s two payment cards go to the ordinary facedown shared discard.
material_wrong_claims.correct_rule: Only another player’s counteroffer-proposal payment cards go to Aaron owner.

records.rationale: The answer generalizes interception to a player without the essential another-player restriction, producing a material wrong actor/destination condition in the supplied owner-proposes-third case. The complete deal quotation does not supply Aaron’s missing restriction or cancel the wrong assertion.
